title: Introducing Spyglass
summary: We are thrilled to announce the full launch of Spyglass, providing you with powerful new insights and enhanced capabilities to elevate your experience.

title: Advanced File Management: Total Control in Your Editor!
summary: Gain unprecedented control over your images and files directly within the editor, making your content creation smoother, more personalized, and visually stunning.

title: Live Product Roadmap
summary: Explore our progress and future vision with the new Live Product Roadmap, transparently showcasing recently completed features, what's next, and exciting plans ahead.

title: Modernized Checkboxes for Seamless Workflow
summary: We've reimagined our checkboxes with a fresh design, making them larger, easier to click, and fully draggable for a truly effortless task management experience.

title: Seamless Teamwork Enhancements
summary: We've made it easier and more intuitive than ever to collaborate with your team, ensuring a seamless and effortless shared editing experience.

title: Effortless Discovery of Shared Content
summary: We've made it simpler to locate and utilize shared content, empowering seamless collaboration across your network.

title: Worldwide Language Availability
summary: Noeko now speaks your language, empowering a truly global user base with comprehensive international language support.

title: Open Sourcing Noeko
summary: We're thrilled to open Noeko's codebase to the community, empowering you with greater control, direct involvement, and complete transparency in its ongoing development.

title: Empowered Constellation for Deeper Insights
summary: Unlock new perspectives on your knowledge base with powerful filtering options for tags, time, and shared items, transforming your Constellation view into an indispensable tool for discovery.

title: Powerful Search & Curated Collections
summary: Unlock a new level of productivity by using our enhanced search to filter and sort your knowledge with precision, then instantly save these refined views as personalized collections.

title: Dynamic Content Display
summary: We're empowering you with flexible and interactive ways to view your linked content, helping you structure your thoughts more intuitively than ever before.

title: Noeko: Self-Hosting & Flexible Plans for Ultimate Control
summary: Take complete control of your data and unlock advanced capabilities with Noeko's new self-hosting option and flexible paid plans, designed to scale with your ambitions.

title: Discover a World of Beautiful New Themes
summary: Elevate your visual experience with a stunning array of new and improved themes, designed to perfectly match your style and preferences.

title: Accurate Time-of-Day Greetings
summary: Experience a more personalized welcome as our app now intelligently displays greetings that perfectly match your local time of day.

title: Streamlined Tag Management
summary: Gain powerful control over your tagged content with new bulk actions, enabling you to swiftly unapply, delete, or explore items right from the tag view.

title: Expand Your Content Horizons
summary: Get ready to effortlessly import and engage with a wide variety of content formats, including YouTube videos, websites, and text files, making it simpler to centralize all your valuable information.
